feed.title: iShares Core S&P Total U.S. Stock Market ETF Holdings

The ETF has significant assets under management and tracks a market cap-weighted index of all common equities listed on the NYSE and NASDAQ. The list highlights major corporate investments, including technology giants like NVIDIA, Apple, and Microsoft, and also provides recent changes in the ETF's holdings, showing detailed share adjustments for various companies.

feed.title: BlackRock launches ETF that expands beyond the ‘Magnificent Seven'
feed.summary: BlackRock's iShares has launched a new ETF, the iShares Top 20 U.S. Stocks ETF (TOPT), aimed at investors looking to diversify beyond the "Magnificent Seven" tech giants. This ETF comprises the 20 largest U.S. stocks by market capitalization, offering a broader and more diversified approach to capturing growth in the U.S. equity market. The launch addresses concerns about the high concentration and valuations of the Magnificent Seven, which recently experienced a significant market cap slide.

Key holdings include NVIDIA, Apple, Eli Lilly, and Microsoft, with a section also listing recent changes in its portfolio.

feed.title: BlackRock launches ETF that expands beyond the ‘Magnificent Seven'
feed.summary: BlackRock's iShares has launched the iShares Top 20 U.S. Stocks ETF (TOPT) to offer investors diversification beyond the "Magnificent Seven" tech giants. This new ETF comprises the 20 largest U.S. stocks by market capitalization, aiming to provide a broader and more diversified investment in leading U.S. companies. The move comes as some investors worry about the concentration of the Magnificent Seven in the S&P 500 and their high valuations.

feed.title: Ford's head of integrated services leaves automaker to join Peloton
feed.summary: Peter Stern, Ford's head of integrated services, is departing the automaker after approximately one year to become CEO of Peloton, effective January 1, 2025. Stern was responsible for developing Ford's recurring revenue from vehicle services. Michael Amend will lead Ford's digital services unit on an interim basis.

feed.title: Lambda CEO Stephen Balaban says S. Korea has Fast-Paced AI Innovation, SKT-Lambda Partnership to Bring Exciting Changes | SK telecom newsroom
feed.summary: Stephen Balaban, CEO of Lambda, discusses their partnership with SK Telecom (SKT) to expand into the AI infrastructure market, including the launch of a GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) in Seoul. Balaban highlights Korea's fast-paced AI innovation and emphasizes Lambda's strategy of building the best product for customers. He will also deliver a keynote speech at the "SK AI Summit 2024" discussing shifts in AI and the growing importance of open models and GPUs.

feed.title: PodcastOne Engages MZ Group to Lead Strategic Investor Relations Program
feed.summary: PodcastOne (PODC) has engaged MZ Group to manage its investor relations and financial communications program to enhance visibility within the investment community. The company, the only pure-play podcast network listed on a US national exchange, highlights its significant content portfolio with 181 exclusive podcasts, 19 million monthly downloads, and 5 million unique listeners, operating in a $2 billion market. This partnership aims to strengthen investor awareness for PodcastOne's unique market position and growth strategy.

feed.title: T. Rowe Price PM a ‘big believer’ in crypto
feed.summary: Dominic Rizzo, who manages T. Rowe Price’s new technology-focused ETF, believes in crypto, DeFi, and stablecoins, seeing numerous future applications for these technologies. He notes that while there aren't many direct public market equity exposures to these trends, Coinbase (COIN) is a key exception within his investment framework due to its role as a "linchpin technology" and its strong fundamentals. Rizzo expects more crypto equity opportunities to emerge as the trend continues to grow.

feed.title: Fidelity MSCI Information Technology Index ETF Holdings
feed.summary: This article details the holdings of the Fidelity MSCI Information Technology Index ETF (FTEC), which launched on October 21, 2013, focusing on information technology equity. The ETF manages $15.298 billion in assets across 286 holdings, tracking a market-cap-weighted index of US information technology stocks. It lists top holdings like NVIDIA, Apple, and Microsoft, and provides a comprehensive log of recent changes in its portfolio.

feed.title: Vanguard Information Technology ETF: 3 Reasons Why Investors Need to Own VGT Right Now
feed.summary: The Vanguard Information Technology ETF (VGT) is highlighted as a strong investment due to its focus on U.S. tech stocks, particularly mega-cap growth companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia. The article discusses VGT's impressive historical performance, its low expense ratio of 0.1%, and its significant exposure to leading technology growth companies, especially those benefiting from AI advancements. Investors are encouraged to consider VGT for long-term portfolio growth, possibly employing a dollar-cost averaging strategy to mitigate volatility.

feed.title: CAE Unveils An Immersive Flight Training Solution Using Virtual Reality
feed.summary: CAE has launched an immersive flight training application utilizing Apple Vision Pro, a virtual reality headset. This new solution allows pilots to train for procedures within a virtual cockpit, adapt to any aircraft type, and practice critical functions from anywhere. The application, which includes exploration, guided, and flight deck interaction modes, is set to officially roll out in Spring 2025.

feed.title: Apple introduces M4 Pro and M4 Max
feed.summary: Apple announced the new M4 Pro and M4 Max chips, expanding the M4 family with enhanced power efficiency and advanced capabilities for Mac. These chips, built on second-generation 3-nanometer technology, feature faster CPUs, GPUs with 2x faster ray-tracing, and significantly increased unified memory bandwidth, along with support for Thunderbolt 5. The M4 Pro and M4 Max are designed to deliver exceptional performance for pro and AI workloads, powering Apple Intelligence on Mac while emphasizing user privacy and environmental benefits.

feed.title: Corning Inc. Earnings Call Highlights Growth and Challenges
feed.summary: Corning Inc.'s Q3 earnings call revealed strong financial performance, especially in Optical Communications, with strategic plans like Springboard and a partnership with Apple driving growth. Despite challenges in the automotive sector and rising operating expenses, the company provided optimistic Q4 guidance, projecting continued expansion and profitability.

feed.title: Cadence raises fourth-quarter profit forecast on robust demand from chip designers
feed.summary: Cadence Design Systems increased its annual profit forecast, driven by strong demand for its chip design software, fueled by the generative AI boom. The company reported a significant rise in September quarter revenue, exceeding estimates, and anticipates further growth from its new Palladium supercomputer. This positive outlook reflects resilient semiconductor firms' R&D expenditure despite economic pressures.

feed.title: 3 Top Dividend ETFs That Could Build Generation-Spanning Wealth
feed.summary: This article highlights three top dividend-focused ETFs—iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF (DGRO), Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF (VYM), and Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD)—as efficient ways to build long-term wealth through compound growth. These ETFs offer low expense ratios and hold high-quality companies with consistent dividend histories, providing a reliable investment strategy amidst market volatility. Each fund is detailed with its investment strategy, top holdings, expense ratio, yield, and historical performance over the past decade.

feed.title: WebexOne 2024: Cisco’s vision for the future of immersive collaboration
feed.summary: At WebexOne 2024, Cisco unveiled significant AI and XR enhancements for its Webex platform, shifting its focus from basic video conferencing to a comprehensive, immersive collaboration suite. Key announcements included the Webex AI Agent for rapid customer service deployment, the expansion of the Cisco AI Assistant, and deeper XR integration with Apple's Vision Pro and Cisco's Room Bar Pro for spatial meetings. These developments, supported by partnerships with Nvidia and Apple, underscore Cisco's commitment to ethical and sustainable innovation in hybrid work environments.

feed.title: COPT plans 1GW data center campus outside Des Moines, Iowa
feed.summary: COPT Defense Properties is planning a 1GW data center campus near Des Moines, Iowa, after acquiring a 365-acre land parcel for $32 million. The campus is projected to include 15 buildings totaling 3.3 million square feet and will serve an existing Fortune 100 cloud computing tenant. This expansion leverages Des Moines' attractive land values, power availability, renewable energy access, and tax incentives.

feed.title: Tap to Pay on iPhone expands to more European countries
feed.summary: Apple has expanded its Tap to Pay on iPhone service to Austria, Czech Republic, Ireland, Romania, and Sweden, allowing millions of merchants to accept contactless payments securely using only an iPhone and a partner-enabled iOS app. This service supports payments from contactless credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets without requiring additional hardware. Several payment platforms like Adyen, SumUp, and Viva.com are among the first to offer Tap to Pay on iPhone in these new countries, with more expected to follow.

feed.title: Apple’s all-new Mac mini is more mighty, more mini, and built for Apple Intelligence
feed.summary: Apple has unveiled an all-new Mac mini, powered by the M4 and M4 Pro chips, featuring significant performance enhancements in a more compact design. This new Mac mini is also built for Apple Intelligence and marks an important environmental milestone as Apple’s first carbon neutral Mac, with over 80 percent reduction in greenhouse gas emissions. Starting at $599, it is available for pre-order today and will be available on November 8.

feed.title: Apple iPhone 16 sales blocked in Indonesia due to local parts rule
feed.summary: Indonesia has blocked sales of the Apple iPhone 16 due to the company's failure to meet local content requirements, which mandate 40% locally manufactured components. While the phones can be brought in for personal use with taxes paid, Apple has not fulfilled its investment commitment for local certification. This decision comes despite Indonesia being a key market and Apple having invested in app developer academies in the country.

feed.title: Worried About the Magnificent 7? This New S&P 500 Fund Excludes Them
feed.summary: A new ETF, the Defiance Large Cap ex-Mag 7 ETF (NASDAQ:XMAG), has launched to address investor concerns about the high valuations of the "Magnificent 7" tech stocks. This fund includes 493 S&P 500 holdings but specifically excludes the seven major tech companies, offering an alternative for investors seeking large-cap exposure with potentially less risk. While it has a higher expense ratio than standard S&P 500 funds, it caters to those looking for a more diversified approach.

feed.title: MoneyGram Names Anthony Soohoo as CEO
feed.summary: MoneyGram International, Inc. has appointed Anthony Soohoo as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Mr. Soohoo, an experienced technology executive with a background in digital transformations, succeeds Alex Holmes, who will transition to an advisory role. His focus will be on executing MoneyGram's digital innovation strategy and expanding its global partner network, leveraging his extensive experience in technology, business, and artificial intelligence.

feed.title: Apple introduces new iMac supercharged by M4 and Apple Intelligence
feed.summary: Apple announced a new iMac featuring the powerful M4 chip and Apple Intelligence, boasting significant performance improvements and new features. This updated iMac comes in a range of new colors, offers a nano-texture display option, an enhanced 12MP Center Stage camera, and improved Thunderbolt 4 connectivity. It starts at $1,299, with pre-orders available immediately and shipping beginning November 8, promising a transformative user experience with AI capabilities and privacy protections.

feed.title: How Nvidia Overtook Apple as World's Most Valuable Company
feed.summary: Nvidia briefly surpassed Apple to become the world's most valuable company, driven by the immense demand for its specialized AI chips crucial for advanced AI applications. This shift highlights the growing importance of AI-driven technologies in the tech market, with Nvidia benefiting significantly from the race among tech giants to dominate AI. While Apple later regained its lead, Nvidia's surge underscores the impact of AI on market valuations and investment trends.

feed.title: Nvidia overtakes Apple as world's most valuable company
feed.summary: Nvidia has surpassed Apple to become the world's most valuable company, driven by robust demand for its specialized AI chips. Its market value briefly touched $3.53 trillion, exceeding Apple's $3.52 trillion, as the tech trio including Microsoft remains in a close race for top market capitalization. The surge in Nvidia's stock is fueled by the ongoing boom in generative AI and strong investment in AI capabilities across various companies.

feed.title: If you invested $10,000 in Apple, Nvidia, or these 8 other stocks in 1999, you'd have over $1 million now
feed.summary: This article examines how a $10,000 investment in specific companies 25 years ago would have yielded over $1 million today. It highlights top performers like Nvidia, Monster Beverage, and Deckers Outdoor, detailing their current worth. The piece also advises against picking individual stocks in favor of diversified investments like index funds due to market unpredictability.

feed.title: Apple supplier Jabil eyes two more India units with $275 million investment
feed.summary: Apple supplier Jabil plans to invest an additional $250-$275 million (Rs 2,102-Rs 2,312 crore) to establish at least two more manufacturing units in India over the next three to four years. This expansion aims to capitalize on India's growing market for consumer electronics and potentially produce components for various Apple products beyond AirPods casings. The move is part of a broader trend of Apple suppliers increasing their manufacturing presence in India to reduce reliance on China.

feed.title: Clear Harbor Asset Management's Strategic Reduction in Intellicheck Holdings
feed.summary: Clear Harbor Asset Management reduced its stake in Intellicheck Inc (NASDAQ:IDN) by selling 178,030 shares at $2.17 each on September 30, 2024. This transaction adjusted Clear Harbor's holding to 1,205,854 shares, representing a 0.03% impact on its portfolio. Intellicheck, a company specializing in identity authentication, is currently valued at $47.859 million and is considered modestly undervalued with a GF Value of $2.87.
